property_summary: For any caller equal to owner and any positive contract balance, calling withdrawAll(recipient) empties the contract (address(c).balance == 0); the mutant that transfers only half can leave a non-zero balance for some fuzzed recipient and initial balance, so the property is violated by the mutant.
change_summary: Replace the transfer amount to send only half of the contract balance (using division by 2) to the recipient instead of the full balance.
